translation.title: Felbinac Cataplasm (Pap)
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of osteoarthritis (degenerative arthritis), periarthritis of the shoulder, tendinitis and tenosynovitis, peritendinitis, epicondylitis of the humerus (such as tennis elbow), muscle pain, and swelling and pain after an injury.
translation.usage: Peel off the release liner and apply 1 cataplasm to the affected area twice a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, if you have had an asthma attack triggered by aspirin or non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, if you have experienced hives or acute rhinitis caused by aspirin or non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, or if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have bronchial asthma, if you have experienced hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to propylene glycol, or if the user is a child. This medicine contains sodium benzoate, which may cause mild irritation to the skin, eyes, and mucous membranes. Do not use it on damaged skin or mucous membranes, or on areas with eczema or rash. Itching, redness, flushing, dermatitis (rash, eczema), or contact dermatitis may occur occasionally, and irritation or blisters rarely. If any of these occur, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature.
